description: This file defines a React component called ProfileForm, which provides a user interface for editing user profile information such as username and avatar. It manages state for form fields, handles image upload, and performs profile updates via a mutation. The component uses hooks like useState, useCallback, useMemo, and integrates with third-party libraries like framer-motion and Clerk for user management.

methods.name: ProfileForm
methods.description: React functional component that renders a user profile editing form, managing username and avatar updates with visual feedback.
